features.description: TwinO — the digital version of your agency in real estate sales
features.card1Description: The AI version of your best agent that never rests. It instantly analyzes budget, location, and the client's real intent directly from WhatsApp/Meta chats. Sales Twin automatically qualifies leads in seconds and connects the agent only with real buyers.
features.card2Description: Say goodbye to manual data entry. The system automatically syncs qualified leads to your CRM and schedules visits in Google Calendar. A process without human errors, where every meeting is pre-confirmed.
features.card3Description: Your property database and client data are your most valuable assets. TwinO ensures complete information isolation and protection in accordance with international GDPR standards. Your leads are accessible only to you.

howItWorks.subtitle: Your Sales Twin responds on all channels — WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram — exactly the way your best sales agent would. It manages all channels simultaneously. Your leads receive instant responses, regardless of which platform they contact you from.
howItWorks.twinDescription: Automatically responding to all incoming inquiries. Watch how it qualifies leads in real-time.
howItWorks.msg1: Hi, I saw your ad. Is it still available?

To select the best options for you: are you considering the property for strategic investment (rental income) or for personal residence? Also, what is your preferred budget for this purchase?
